preconditions.description: The size of the grid n must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.
Alice's chosen color a must be one of the three colors: 1, 2, or 3.
Bob's chosen color b must be one of the three colors and must not be equal to Alice's color a.

postconditions.description: Bob's output must be in the format of three integers: b, i, j, representing the color and position of the token placed.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n for i, j in placed_tokens)
postconditions.description: All placed tokens must be within the bounds of the grid.
After n^2 turns, the grid must be completely filled with tokens.

invariants.description: The number of placed tokens must not exceed the total number of cells in the grid.

invariants.expression: all((i, j) not in placed_tokens for i, j in placed_tokens)
invariants.description: No cell can be occupied more than once; all placed tokens must be in unique cells.

invariants.expression: all((i, j) not in placed_tokens for i, j in placed_tokens)
invariants.description: No two adjacent cells can contain tokens of the same color.
